reviewer_notes: REVIEW: MedLM (Google Cloud's healthcare-tuned generative AI/LLM) for medical-claims document analysis. Coded as STRATEGIC, not operational, because the company's own risk-management passage explicitly calls it a 'pilot launch', and the original October 2024 press release (also an approved source this session) describes a bounded 3-4 month test in Singapore/Malaysia only, comparing MedLM's output to human decisions with a 'human in the loop' -- i.e. an evaluation phase, not a confirmed production deployment. A second passage in the same annual report (p.113) uses more definite 'launched'/'is expediting' language, which is noted as a genuine internal inconsistency but not treated as sufficient on its own to override the company's explicit 'pilot' self-description elsewhere. Per Core Rule 4 and this controller's rule against classifying pilots as operational, excluded from the operational count; may be revisited if the pilot's graduation to production is confirmed in a future report.
